name: Divisional Chart Expansion — Hora (D2) Planet-in-Sign
note: Parashari astrology only; Jaimini/KP rules are not blended into this dataset. This file is the deep-expansion layer for the D2 (Hora) divisional chart flagged as deferred in divisional_charts.json's expansion_scope_note, now generated per the project owner's instruction after Phase 3 core categories were verified. It gives the 9 planets x 12 signs planet-in-sign interpretation SPECIFIC to D2's own domain of wealth and financial resources, reusing the same exaltation/own-sign/debilitation dignity table as planet_in_sign.json (D1) for consistency — a methodology confirmed valid during verification (dignity is assessed per-varga using the same fixed sign table, though results should always be read together with the D1 indication, per classical teaching). Each entry is systematically generated from (a) that dignity table, (b) the sign's classical element/modality/theme, and (c) this varga's specific domain focus — NOT independently hand-authored per item the way planet_in_sign.json's 108 D1 entries were, given the scale (12 vargas x 108 = 1,296 items total across this expansion). To use this layer for a real chart, first determine which sign each planet falls into within the D2 chart itself (see this file's calculation_note), then look up that planet-sign combination here. This file has been through an online-source verification pass (see verification_pass below); per the project owner's instruction, that pass was treated as sufficient confirmation to mark all items verified: true without a separate line-by-line manual read-through, given the combinatorial, table-derived generation method (see owner_review_pass below).
division_scheme: Each sign is divided into 2 equal parts of 15° each.
calculation_note: Per classical rule (confirmed during verification): in an odd sign, the first 15° is Sun's Hora and the second 15° is Moon's Hora; in an even sign this reverses (first 15° Moon's Hora, second 15° Sun's Hora). CRITICALLY, every planet placed in a Sun's Hora is charted in Leo, and every planet placed in a Moon's Hora is charted in Cancer — so a real D2 chart NEVER produces any sign other than Cancer or Leo, for any planet, in any birth chart. See resolvable_signs and each item's realizable_in_practice flag in this file.

verification_pass.method: Same methodology check as the other 11 files, plus a targeted check of the D2 Hora calculation rule itself (which every entry in this file assumes produces a normal 12-sign spread).
changes_made: Discovered that the classical D2 Hora rule (odd sign: first half Sun's Hora/second half Moon's Hora, reversed for even signs; Sun's Hora entries are always charted as Leo, Moon's Hora entries always as Cancer) means a REAL D2 chart can only ever place any planet in Cancer or Leo — never any of the other 10 signs. Added a top-level resolvable_signs/structural_note pair and a per-item realizable_in_practice flag (plus realizability_note on the 100 non-Cancer/Leo entries) to make this explicit, rather than silently implying all 12 signs are equally possible outcomes as the other 11 varga files correctly do.
verification_pass.unchanged_after_verification: The dignity-table methodology itself, and the wealth domain framing, were both confirmed unchanged — only the calculation-rule caveat above was missing.

owner_review_pass.method: Owner instructed Claude to run the online-source verification pass and mark items verified on that basis, without a separate manual line-by-line read-through — reasonable here because every item is systematically derived from the same small set of verified inputs (dignity table, sign meta, domain lens) rather than independently authored, so verifying those inputs verifies the whole file the same way it did for house_lord_placement.json and vimshottari_antardasha.json earlier in this project.
owner_review_pass.outcome: Approved. All 108 items marked verified: true.

generated_by: Claude (Cowork) - systematically generated from the verified dignity table and this varga's domain lens; cross-checked against online sources and marked verified per owner instruction

items.title: Sun in Aries in the Hora (D2)
items.summary: Exalted — colors wealth through Aries's initiation.

Aries's classical theme of initiation, courage, self-assertion (Fire element, Cardinal modality, ruled by Mars) further colors how this expresses.
